**DS064** is a medical diagnosis code representing traumatic epidural hemorrhage. Within the Danish healthcare system, it plays a specific role in monitoring the safety of treatments for patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. 

The code is utilized in the national clinical quality indicators to track the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] and severe bleeding among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. Because these patients are often prescribed anticoagulants, monitoring bleeding complications is a critical measure of treatment safety and quality [^src3]. To capture these events accurately, DS064 is grouped with a broader set of diagnostic codes, including [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds065|DS065]], and [[ds066|DS066]], to define the numerator for intracranial bleeding indicators [^src1]. 

Furthermore, DS064 is part of an even wider array of codes used to identify severe bleeding incidents across different bodily systems, which includes gastrointestinal and respiratory/urinary tract bleeding codes [^src1]. The consistent application of DS064 and its related codes across the 2023, 2024, and 2025 annual reports from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) highlights its ongoing importance as a standardized metric for evaluating cardiovascular care and anticoagulation safety in Denmark [^src2] [^src4] [^src5].
